# lean-pkg update

set fields of an already-registered package (register is for NEW ones).

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg update [--automation AUTOMATION] [--notes TEXT] [--replace-notes]
                [--upstream-target {none,mathlib,palomar}]
                [--doi-track {palomar,doi-only}] [--accept-docs-descendants]
                [--no-accept-docs-descendants] [--build-inputs GLOB,GLOB]
                [--write-binding-file] [--reaudit-after ISO8601]
                [--owner-project OWNER_PROJECT] [--url URL] [--license-spdx SPDX]
                [--formalization-yaml REL] [--headline-config REL] [--paper-arxiv ID]
                [--paper-status {unpublished,preprint,published}]
                [--source-paper-title TITLE] [--source-paper-author NAME]
                [--source-paper-arxiv ID] [--source-paper-doi DOI] [--ai-tool TOOL]
                [--ai-role ROLE] [--append-note TEXT] [--namespace-note TEXT]
                [--namespace NS]
                [--status {scratch,active,gate-pending,verified-private,public,upstreamed,archived}]
                [--reason REASON] [--redetect] [--agent AGENT] [--force]
                [--path HOME-RELATIVE] [--withdraw-publication]
                [--release-publication-hold] [--dry-run] [common flags] NAME
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |   |
| `--automation AUTOMATION` | AI-disclosure note; required by mathlib when upstream_target is mathlib |
| `--notes TEXT` | set the notes; refused when notes exist unless --replace-notes (use --append-note) |
| `--replace-notes` | with --notes: replace non-empty notes (the old text stays in history as notes_from) |
| `--upstream-target {none,mathlib,palomar}` | Choices: `none`, `mathlib`, `palomar`. |
| `--doi-track {palomar,doi-only}` | the DOI track (needs --reason): doi-only lets a public package record doi-minted without a palomar-\* event; palomar (the default when absent) keeps rule doi-in-palomar (old spelling --track, kept working). Choices: `palomar`, `doi-only`. |
| `--accept-docs-descendants` | deprecated (WARN; removed no earlier than 1.0.0): the registry route of the docs-only opt-in, replaced by a committed lean-pkg-binding.yaml (--write-binding-file). Opt in (needs --reason): a receipt bound to commit C is also accepted at a descendant of C where no build input under the package directory changed (\*.lean, lakefile.\*, lake-manifest.json, lean-toolchain, --build-inputs globs, the checker's files; never a symlink/gitlink change, .gitattributes, .gitmodules, .lfsconfig, claims.yaml, nor those attribute files in a directory above a subdirectory package); the gated commit stays C (docs/receipts.md); --dry-run supported |
| `--no-accept-docs-descendants` | opt out again (needs --reason): only the evidence-only rule applies |
| `--build-inputs GLOB,GLOB` | extra build inputs for the docs-only rule (needs --reason): comma-separated package-relative fnmatch globs (`*` crosses /; a glob without / also matches a basename), replacing the recorded list; '' clears it |
| `--write-binding-file` | write lean-pkg-binding.yaml (schema lean-pkg-binding/1) into the package directory from the record's docs_descendants: true and build_inputs, the migration off the deprecated registry route; writes nothing (exit 0) when the record does not opt in; an identical file is a no-op, a different file or a symlink is refused (exit 1); never staged or committed, and the registry is not written. On its own (no field, --status or --path); --dry-run prints the file |
| `--reaudit-after ISO8601` |   |
| `--owner-project OWNER_PROJECT` |   |
| `--url URL` | remote URL (e.g. after publishing a private dep) (old spelling --repo, kept working) |
| `--license-spdx SPDX` | the package's license as an SPDX id or expression, e.g. 'MIT OR Apache-2.0' (what the index and Reservoir expect) |
| `--formalization-yaml REL` | repository-relative path of the package's formalization.yaml |
| `--headline-config REL` | repository-relative path of the headline comparator configuration (the paper's main results, fed to formalization.yaml status.main_results); '' clears it (then comparator.headline.json applies when tracked) |
| `--paper-arxiv ID` | arXiv id of the paper this package verifies (sets paper.arxiv; status defaults to preprint) |
| `--paper-status {unpublished,preprint,published}` | the verified paper's status; promote refuses while unpublished without an arXiv id. Choices: `unpublished`, `preprint`, `published`. |
| `--source-paper-title TITLE` | title of the formalized paper (source_paper.title; rendered into formalization.yaml acknowledgements, #22.6) |
| `--source-paper-author NAME` | an author of the formalized paper (repeatable; the list replaces the recorded one). Credited in acknowledgements, never in project.authors; no consent needed |
| `--source-paper-arxiv ID` | arXiv id of the formalized paper (source_paper.arxiv) |
| `--source-paper-doi DOI` | DOI of the formalized paper (source_paper.doi) |
| `--ai-tool TOOL` | an AI tool used (repeatable; the list replaces the recorded one; ai_assistance.tools) |
| `--ai-role ROLE` | what the AI tools did (repeatable; replaces; ai_assistance.roles) |
| `--append-note TEXT` | append a line `YYYY-MM-DD (AGENT): TEXT` (UTC date, --agent) to notes, keeping what is there; --notes replaces instead |
| `--namespace-note TEXT` | record why this package shares a Lean root namespace with another (namespace_notes); audit's duplicate-namespace is info once both packages carry a note for it |
| `--namespace NS` | with --namespace-note: the namespace (repeatable); default every root namespace this checkout shares with another registered package |
| `--status {scratch,active,gate-pending,verified-private,public,upstreamed,archived}` | manual transitions only; verified-private is gate's and public is promote's. Choices: `scratch`, `active`, `gate-pending`, `verified-private`, `public`, `upstreamed`, `archived`. |
| `--reason REASON` | required for --status and --force |
| `--redetect` | re-read lean_toolchain and mathlib_pin from the repo |
| `--agent AGENT` | lease holder, if one is live |
| `--force` | override a live lease held by another agent; needs --reason |
| `--path HOME-RELATIVE` | relocate: move local_path to another checkout, keeping name, history and claims (needs --reason; event relocated; commit-bound evidence not bound to the new HEAD is cleared) |
| `--withdraw-publication` | the owner made a promoted (public) repository private again: record it (needs --reason; refused while gh still reports it public). status public -&gt; verified-private (active when never gated), visibility private, publication_hold {reason, at, by}; promotion history kept; promote refuses while held; gate/regate keep the hold; --dry-run supported |
| `--release-publication-hold` | lift a publication hold (needs --reason); status and visibility unchanged; a later public flip still goes through promote |
| `--dry-run` | with --path, --withdraw-publication or --release-publication-hold: print the would-be changes, write nothing; with --write-binding-file: print the file |

## Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `update NAME` | set fields; manual status moves and `--force` need `--reason` (else a refusal, exit 1); empty `--url`/`--owner-project` are refused (`--notes ''` clears); `--notes TEXT` over non-empty notes is refused (exit 2, nothing written, no event; `--json` `{"ok": false, "usage": true, "error"}`) unless `--replace-notes` is given, and the refusal names `--append-note`, `--replace-notes` and the recovery of replaced text from history (the `updated` event's `notes_from`); on empty notes `--notes` needs no flag; with `--replace-notes` it replaces the notes, the event carries `notes_replaced: true`, and, when it drops earlier text, it prints "replaced notes were: ..." and "use --append-note to keep the previous note" (JSON `hint`); `--append-note TEXT --agent A` appends the line `YYYY-MM-DD (A): TEXT` (UTC date) to the notes, creating them if absent, and cannot be combined with `--notes`; its text output prints only `appended note: YYYY-MM-DD (A): TEXT` (the full before/after stays in the event's `notes_from` and in `--json` `changes.notes`); `--license-spdx` takes an SPDX identifier or expression (`MIT OR Apache-2.0`); `--path` uses the `register` normaliser and the current checkout is a no-op (exit 0); `public` to `upstreamed` needs a recorded `mathlib-pr-merged`/`palomar-registered` event or a URL in `--reason`; any status may move to `archived`; a refused move lists the allowed ones; schema errors already in the registry (another package's) are reported on stderr as pre-existing and do not block (same for `register` and `record`) `record`); `--track palomar|doi-only` sets the optional DOI `track` (needs `--reason`; event `updated` with `track` in `fields`; see `record` for what `doi-only` allows; `validate` refuses any other value); `--accept-docs-descendants` / `--no-accept-docs-descendants` set the optional `docs_descendants` true/false and `--build-inputs GLOB,GLOB` replaces the optional `build_inputs` list (`''` clears it; package-relative, no leading `/` or `..`): each needs `--reason` (else refused, nothing written), records event `updated` with the field in `fields` and its old value as `<field>_from`, follows the lease rule, and accepts `--dry-run` (event `update-dry-run`, nothing written); see [Docs-only descendants](../receipts.md#docs-only-descendants-opt-in). `--accept-docs-descendants` is deprecated (the committed `lean-pkg-binding.yaml` replaces the registry route): it prints `WARN: deprecated: ...` on stderr and adds `deprecations[]` to `--json`; the veto `--no-accept-docs-descendants` is not deprecated. `--write-binding-file` writes `lean-pkg-binding.yaml` into the package directory from the record's `docs_descendants: true` and `build_inputs` (the migration): never staged or committed, the registry not written; nothing (exit 0) when the record does not opt in; an identical file is a no-op; a different file, a symlink or a directory is refused (exit 1, untouched); `--dry-run` prints the file; with a field, `--status` or `--path` it is a usage error (exit 2); it prints the commit advice (commit it on its own right before the next verify run) | `--status` `--reason` `--automation` `--notes [--replace-notes]` `[--append-note TEXT --agent A]` `--upstream-target` `--reaudit-after` `--owner-project` `--url` `--redetect` `--agent` `--force` `[--accept-docs-descendants \| --no-accept-docs-descendants] [--build-inputs GLOB,GLOB] --reason T [--dry-run]` `[--write-binding-file [--dry-run]]` `[--license-spdx SPDX]` `[--formalization-yaml REL]` `[--headline-config REL]` (the optional `headline_config`: the [headline configuration](../comparator.md#headline-configuration-the-papers-main-results); repository-relative `.json`; `''` clears it) `[--paper-arxiv ID]` `[--paper-status unpublished|preprint|published]` (the optional `paper` field of a paper-coupled package; an arXiv id alone sets status `preprint`) `[--source-paper-title T] [--source-paper-author NAME]... [--source-paper-arxiv ID] [--source-paper-doi DOI]` (the optional `source_paper` {title, authors[], arxiv, doi}: the formalized paper, credited in formalization.yaml's `acknowledgements` and never in `project.authors`, so its authors need no consent row; a repeated flag's list replaces the recorded one, other keys are kept; it needs a title, an arXiv id or a DOI) `[--ai-tool T]... [--ai-role R]...` (the optional `ai_assistance` {tools[], roles[]}, rendered into `acknowledgements` as `AI assistance: TOOLS for ROLES.`) `[--namespace-note TEXT [--namespace NS]...]` (records in the optional `namespace_notes` why this package shares a Lean root namespace with another, such as a comparator `Challenge`/`Solution` layout; without `--namespace`, every root namespace the checkout shares with another registered package; notes for other namespaces are kept; `audit`'s `duplicate-namespace` becomes `info` once every package sharing the namespace carries a note for it) `[--path HOME-RELATIVE --reason TEXT [--dry-run]]` (relocate: event `relocated`; the output ends with a `binding at the new path` block: each recorded receipt's commit against the new HEAD with the evidence-only verdict, the `formalization.yaml` exception (pointer, changed, derived-only), other changes since the receipt commit, then `next:` with the command(s) to run, such as `lean-pkg gate NAME --receipt R [--refresh-formalization]`, `lean-pkg update NAME --formalization-yaml REL` when only a missing pointer clears a derived-only regeneration, `lean-pkg receipt comparator` + `lean-pkg comparator`, `claims sync`, or `nothing to re-gate`; JSON `binding` {head, receipt, comparator, formalization, other_changes} and `next_commands[]`) `[--withdraw-publication --reason TEXT [--dry-run]]` (privacy withdrawal: the owner made a promoted repository private again; on its own, `public` status only (an `upstreamed` one is withdrawn upstream), refused while `gh` still reports the repository public (lean-pkg never changes visibility here; a failed or non-GitHub query is noted, not a refusal); status `public -> verified-private` (`active` when no gate receipt is recorded), `visibility: private`, and `publication_hold` {reason, at, by} (`by`: `--agent`, else `unknown`); `promoted_at`, `promoted_commit` and the `promoted` event are kept; one `publication-withdrawn` event {status_from, status_to, visibility_from, visibility_to, reason, by, github_visibility, promoted_commit, forced}; while held, `promote` (and the promote checklist of `publish`) fails with `✗ publication hold since AT by BY: REASON`, `next` recommends nothing to publish, `gate`/`--regate` keep the hold, `audit --fix` never flips a held record public; see [Lifecycle](../lifecycle.md#withdrawing-publication)) `[--release-publication-hold --reason TEXT [--dry-run]]` (lift the hold: status and visibility unchanged, event `publication-hold-released` {reason, hold, by, forced}; a public flip still goes through `promote`) |

## Exit codes

0 success (dry runs and no-ops included), 1 refused or failed, 2 usage error; see [Exit codes](../cli.md#exit-codes).

## JSON output

Top-level keys of `--json`, as recorded in the golden contract (tests/golden/json-keys.json):

- `update` (exit 0): `changes`, `event`, `forced`, `name`, `ok`, `reason`
- `update-path-dry-run` (exit 0): `binding`, `cleared`, `dry_run`, `event`, `name`, `new_path`, `next_commands`, `notes`, `ok`, `old_path`, `redetected`, `status`

## Examples

Set a field of a registered package (register is only for new ones).

```bash
lean-pkg update my-proof --license-spdx Apache-2.0
```

Print the lean-pkg-binding.yaml the record's docs_descendants and build_inputs give; nothing written.

```bash
lean-pkg update my-proof --write-binding-file --dry-run
```

Write it into the package directory (the migration off the deprecated registry route; never staged, the registry untouched), then commit it on its own right before the next verify run.

```bash
lean-pkg update my-proof --write-binding-file
```
